instruct: A young adult American male presenter in his early twenties, with a light bright tenor and a little natural vocal texture. Engaged, curious and conversational, like a thoughtful young technology journalist explaining a chart to a friend. Natural moderate pace around 125 words per minute, deliberately unhurried. Speak slowly, with a thoughtful pause between EVERY sentence. Use clear sentence breaks and real breathing pauses, especially after figures and before the main point. Express energy through varied intonation and confident emphasis, not speed or loudness. Relaxed, warm, spontaneous and clear. No deep bass, gravelly documentary voice, exaggerated commercial announcer delivery, robotic cadence, rushed words or constant high intensity. Clean close microphone studio speech.
